Total training allocation consequently falls from 16 to 12 GB, not by half, on the same device, model and precision. A proposal contains five candidate tokens, with each guess conditioned on its predecessors, and the target evaluates the proposed prefix positions. The correction rule retains the target distribution. On the toy workload, proposal work takes 4 ms, a target round takes 20 ms, and accepted yield averages three tokens. Proposal length, target-round cost and accepted yield therefore provide distinct descriptions of the evaluated configuration.
